name: organism-relationship
title: Organism Relationship
description: A dwc:ResourceRelationship of one dwc:Organism to another dwc:Organism.
notes: An OrganismRelationship must be a permanent relationship. Ephemeral relationships between dwc:Organisms should be recorded as dwc:OrganismInteractions.
examples: `an instance of a dwc:Organism is the mother of another instance of a dwc:Organism`

fields.name: organismRelationshipID
fields.title: Organism Relationship ID
fields.notes: The value in this field MUST be preserved in aggregation. Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.

fields.name: subjectOrganism_fk
fields.title: Subject Organism (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:Organism that is the subject of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: relationshipType
fields.title: Relationship Type
fields.description: A relationship of a subject resource (identified by dwc:subjectOrganismID) to a related resource (identified by dwc:relatedOrganismID).
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.
fields.examples: `same as`; `duplicate of`; `mother of`; `offspring of`; `sibling of`; `parasite of`; `host of`; `valid synonym of`; `located within`; `pollinator of members of taxon`; `pollinated specific plant`; `pollinated by members of taxon`; `on slab with`

fields.name: relationshipTypeIRI
fields.title: Relationship Type IRI
fields.description: An IRI of a controlled vocabulary value for the type of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use an IRI for a term in a controlled vocabulary.
fields.examples: `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002456` (for the relation pollinated by); `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002455` (for the relation pollinates); `https://www.inaturalist.org/observation_fields/879` (for the relation eaten by)

fields.name: relationshipTypeSource
fields.title: Relationship Type Source
fields.description: A reference to a controlled vocabulary in which the definition of a value in dwc:relationshipType is given.

fields.name: relatedOrganism_fk
fields.title: Related Organism (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for the related dwc:Organism (the object) of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: relatedOrganismID
fields.title: Related Organism ID
fields.description: An identifier for the related dwc:Organism (the object) of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY refer to a dwc:Organism within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.

fields.name: externalRelatedOrganismID
fields.title: External Related Organism ID
fields.description: An identifier for the related dwc:Organism (the object) of a dwc:ResourceRelationship that is not within the same dataset.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.

fields.name: externalRelatedOrganismSource
fields.title: External Related Organism Source
fields.description: A reference to a source outside the dataset where the related dwc:Organism record can be found.

fields.name: relationshipAccordingTo
fields.title: Relationship According To
fields.description: A name of a dcterms:Agent responsible for asserting a dwc:ResourceRelationship.

fields.name: relationshipAccordingTo_fk
fields.title: Relationship According To (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for asserting a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the related primary key.

fields.name: relationshipAccordingToID
fields.title: Relationship According To ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for asserting a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY refer to a dcterms:Agent within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.

fields.name: relationshipEstablishedDate
fields.title: Relationship Established Date
fields.description: A date on which a dwc:ResourceRelationship was established.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019.

fields.name: relationshipRemarks
fields.title: Relationship Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about a dwc:ResourceRelationship.
